columnPool.label: Route: Sevenoaks Main Line
columnPool.display: Is part of the Sevenoaks Main Line route
columnPool.hint: The direct route from London Cannon Street/Charing Cross via Grove Park and Orpington to Sevenoaks and on to Tonbridge - the fast, principal route south to Kent.

columnPool.label: Route: Catford Loop Extended
columnPool.display: Is part of the Catford Loop Extended route
columnPool.hint: The full Catford Loop route including its city-end approaches via Elephant & Castle/Blackfriars, looping through Nunhead, Catford and Shortlands to rejoin the Chatham Main Line - a relief route avoiding the Sydenham Hill Tunnel.

columnPool.label: Route: Sevenoaks Metro
columnPool.display: Is part of the Sevenoaks Metro route
columnPool.hint: The slower stopping service between London and Sevenoaks via the same route as the Sevenoaks Main Line, calling at more of the intermediate stations.

columnPool.label: Route: Bromley South Metro
columnPool.display: Is part of the Bromley South Metro route
columnPool.hint: The stopping service between London Victoria and Bromley South via Herne Hill and Beckenham Junction, calling at more intermediate stations than the Bromley South Main Line fast service.

columnPool.label: Route: Greenwich Line
columnPool.display: Is part of the Greenwich Line route
columnPool.hint: The historic route from London Bridge via Deptford, Greenwich and Charlton to Woolwich Arsenal - one of the earliest railways in the world, opened in 1836.

columnPool.label: Route: Catford Corridor
columnPool.display: Is part of the Catford Corridor route
columnPool.hint: The core central section of stations shared by the Catford Loop services, running through Herne Hill, Penge East and Beckenham Hill.

columnPool.label: Route: Catford Loop
columnPool.display: Is part of the Catford Loop route
columnPool.hint: The suburban stopping service via Nunhead, Catford and Shortlands, opened in 1892 as a relief route for London Victoria-Kent coast trains - also a diversionary route avoiding the Sydenham Hill Tunnel.

columnPool.label: Route: Bexleyheath Line
columnPool.display: Is part of the Bexleyheath Line route
columnPool.hint: The middle of the three routes from London to Dartford, running via Falconwood, Bexleyheath and Barnehurst.

columnPool.label: Route: Hayes Branch
columnPool.display: Is part of the Hayes Branch route
columnPool.hint: The short branch from Elmers End via Eden Park and West Wickham to its terminus at Hayes (Kent).

columnPool.label: Route: Chatham Main Line Metro
columnPool.display: Is part of the Chatham Main Line Metro route
columnPool.hint: The stopping service on the Chatham Main Line as far as Orpington, calling at the closer-in suburban stations.

columnPool.label: Route: Bromley South Main Line
columnPool.display: Is part of the Bromley South Main Line route
columnPool.hint: The fast route from London via Bickley to Bromley South and on to the Chatham Main Line towards the Kent coast.

columnPool.label: Route: Chatham Main Line
columnPool.display: Is part of the Chatham Main Line route
columnPool.hint: The historic route from London via Bromley South, Swanley and Rochester to Chatham and the Medway towns, continuing to Faversham and Dover.

columnPool.label: Route: Bromley North Branch
columnPool.display: Is part of the Bromley North Branch route
columnPool.hint: The short shuttle branch from Grove Park via Sundridge Park to its terminus at Bromley North.
